metadata.note: 1984 European, without catalyst. Short primaries (about 0.20 m, all twelve taken alike, x 40 mm from 35.5 mm) join three by three (cylinders 1-3, 4-6, 7-9, 10-12), and the pipes after them are long (about 0.86 and 0.74 m, x 54 mm from 47 mm). Each side's two enter its central silencer and run through its side silencer to its tail; the sides do not meet. Each side: a chamber with the wool (0.56 m x 186 mm, 15.2 L), 0.08 m x 74 mm, a chamber (0.48 m x 190 mm, 13.6 L), its tail (0.52 m x 84 mm); the chambers 57.7 L in all, 11.7 times the displacement. The real pipe from the central to the side silencer (about 0.26 to 0.43 m) is written as the 0.08 m between chambers, so the tail is longer than the car's (about 0.26 m). Lengths are estimates from eurospares' parts diagram 019 (about +-20 %). The pipes' diameters are the real car's inner diameters times 1.14, the primaries' included; the expansion chambers' (silencers' bodies') sizes and places, the 1.14 and the 20 mm of wool were set by ear (K, 2026-11-22). Lengths are in steps of 0.02 m. Valve: two exhaust valves of 28 mm and 9.5 mm lift (estimates); about 280 deg seat to seat, from 54 BBDC / 10 ATDC at 0.5 mm (shop manual via owners' forum).
